question: Which amendment of the Constitution of India increased the elective strength of the Lok Sabha from 525 to 545 members?
solution:
The correct answer is__** 31st**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **31st amendment of the Constitution of India increased the elective strength of the Lok Sabha from 525 to 545 members.**
 
• **The 31st Constitutional Amendment Act:**
 
 
• In 1973 the seats of Lok Sabha were increased from **525 to 545.**
 
• The purpose of this act was to increase the representation of states in the Lok Sabha.
 
• The main reason behind this amendment was the population of India revealed in the **Census of 1971.**
 
• This amendment reduced the representation of **UTs in Lok Sabha from 25 to 20.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The 37th constitutional amendment act:**

 
 
• The 37th constitutional amendment act 1975 deals with the formation of the Arunachal Pradesh legislative assembly.
 
 
 
• **50th Amendment:**
 
 
• 50th Amendment Restriction on the Fundamental Rights of persons employed in intelligence organizations and telecommunication systems set up for the armed forces or intelligence organizations.
 
 
 
• **45th Amendment:**
 
 
• Extension to the reservation of seats for the SCS and STS.
